input.title: ZM3D playable - brief for PlayableX
input.bodyText:
ZM3D playable - brief for PlayableX
Zombie Match 3D (on the stores as Puzzles vs Zombies). Prepared by Julia Lawson, 1 October 2025.

This brief describes the game as it is today. We are considering a change to the core gameplay; if the core changes, we will redo the affected parts of this brief with you in November.

1. Start date
Kickoff is Monday 3 November 2025. The project is parked until then.

2. Scenario
We picked Scenario 1: the basic core gameplay, presented in its simplest and most authentic form.
What it is for: retention rather than cheap installs. The playable should show the real game so it filters out players who would not enjoy it, and the people who install already understand what they are getting.
How it plays: the player picks items freely from the board and can keep making matches for as long as they are good enough (not on rails like the Domino Delights playable).

3. How a level plays (from the game design page)
- Items sit in a 3D physics pile on the board. The player taps items to move them into a tray at the bottom.
- The tray has 7 slots.
- Collect 3 matching items in the tray and they clear. Each cleared triple is thrown at the zombies, who walk towards the player from the top of the screen. The cannon (what you called the rocket launcher) fires the projectile.
- Different items hit zombies differently (for example the grenade is powerful, the couch does splash damage, a plushie is weak but funny).
- If all 7 slots fill without a match, that is a blunder: the tray clears and the surviving zombies enrage (get stronger), but play continues. A blunder is not a loss.
- Win: every zombie on screen is eliminated.
- Lose: the zombies reach us and our HP runs out (zero health).
Reference: the reference level Brian recorded for you on 23 September (built on the playable levels branch), with the background from the first zip.

4. The board: 8 items
Grenade, Couch, Plushie Chick (these three are from the reference level), plus Shuriken, Cute Axe, Gift Box, Cactus Plant and Dynamite.
Every other board item on our pack list is an extra you can swap in on the board for testing. The hand-off list (linked below) marks each board item as Default (one of the 8) or Extra.

5. Zombies and animation
Four zombies: Party Girl, Plumber, Magician, Football Player. All four are in the Unity pack Marcus sent on 26 September.
One animation: walk. Please re-rig these four in Spine and apply the walk animation to them. We may add more zombies later depending on scope and size.

6. Sound
- You can use: Matching sound, Success sound, Failure sound. These were made in-house and are ours to hand over.
- Background music: a new track made in-house for the ad (not the in-game track). It is ours, and it is coming once Calvin has cut it down to a loop.
- Rocket sound and Explosion sound: the in-game versions come from a sound library and a bought pack, so they stay with us. Calvin is making our own versions and we will send them when they exist. Until then, please leave these two as placeholders.
- Music start: as with the Domino Delights playable, the music starts only after the player's first tap/click (your rule).

7. Formats (as you asked)
- 3D: .fbx (Binary, not ASCII), .glb or .blend
- 2D: .png (character parts separated into pieces for 2D animation)
- Font: .ttf or .woff2
- Sound: .mp3 or .wav

8. What is still coming from us
The hand-off list sheet has one row per line of our pack list, with its state:
- Delivered: you have the current file and can use it.
- Ready: exported in a format you take, in our outgoing folder, opens, current, and nobody is changing it.
- Owed: anything else; the row says what is owed and who on our side has it.
As of 1 October: 8 Delivered, 36 Ready, 52 Owed (96 lines).
Of the 8 board items, Grenade, Couch and Plushie Chick are Delivered; Shuriken, Cute Axe, Gift Box and Dynamite are Ready; Cactus Plant is Owed (new colour versions, coming from Claire).
Also owed: some FBX files that were saved as ASCII and must be re-exported as Binary, the bathroom set (being re-UV'd), the music instruments zip (damaged on upload), item visuals and UI elements as PNG, the fonts, the background music loop, and our own rocket and explosion sounds.

Contacts on our side: Frederick Stone (project), Julia Lawson (design/brief), Brian Foster (asset pack), Robert (product).

text:
Done. Brief and hand-off list are in my Drive and shared view-only with you, Brian, Robert and PlayableX intake.
• Brief: https://docs.google.com/document/d/f7ba7c0ecaf1057aee7e3017/edit
• Hand-off list: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1HpnHHvAnOqRtpDGUPtMisY74u7XH2J3TLiIvZjez1Os/edit

Where the pack stands (96 lines on Brian's list):
• *Delivered: 8*
• *Ready: 36*
• *Owed: 52*

Most of the Owed lines didn't come from Brian's notes. They come from things said after he wrote them:
• 12 models Brian saved out of Unity on 25 Sep are ASCII FBX (Marcus flagged it on 26 Sep), so they need re-exporting as Binary (Brian)
• Claire is re-UVing the bathroom set, and the 12 files she gave on Friday are the old version (Claire)
• Robert made new colour versions of Cactus, Chainsaw and Cone, so those go again (Claire). Cactus is one of the 8 board items.
• The 26 Sep instruments zip got cut off on upload, so those 8 aren't in the outgoing folder (Brian)
• Rocket and explosion sounds are library/bought, so they stay here until Calvin makes ours
On the board, 7 of the 8 are Delivered or Ready; Cactus is the only one owed. The 52 Owed tickets are in Todo with a comment saying who has each.

Hi PlayableX team, ahead of the Nov 3 kickoff, here are the ZM3D playable brief and our hand-off list. Both are shared view-only with your intake address.
• *Brief* (Scenario 1, the 8 board items, 4 zombies + walk animation, win/lose and the 7-slot tray, sound, start date): https://docs.google.com/document/d/f7ba7c0ecaf1057aee7e3017/edit
• *Hand-off list* (every asset line, marked Delivered / Ready / Owed): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1HpnHHvAnOqRtpDGUPtMisY74u7XH2J3TLiIvZjez1Os/edit

Today it's 8 Delivered, 36 Ready and 52 still coming from us. The Owed rows say what's still coming. The brief is written for the game as it is today; if the core changes, we'll redo that part with you in November.
